"""冻结第91轮完整方向精度桥与原公开协议，不执行LP。"""
import copy
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / 'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(name):
    return json.loads((DATA / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))


def save(name, value):
    with (DATA / name).open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')


previous, docs, production = read('v93-closeout.json'), read('v93-document-check.json'), read('ipm-v66-identity.json')
assert previous['passed'] and previous['production_unchanged'] and previous['total_public_lp_runs_revalidated'] == 136
assert docs['passed'] and all(docs['round90_changelog_coverage'].values())
assert all(sha(ROOT / name) == digest for name, digest in docs['document_sha256'].items())
assert all(sha(ROOT / name) == digest for name, digest in previous['archive']['members'].items())
files = {name: sha(ROOT / name) for name in production['files']}
libraries = {name: sha(ROOT / name) for name in production['libraries']}
assert files == production['files'] and libraries == production['libraries'] and (len(files), len(libraries)) == (95, 17)
assert sha(ROOT / 'build/release/solver.exe') == sha(ROOT / '.tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe') == production['solver_sha256']
assert sha(DATA / 'ipm-v66-source.zip') == production['source_zip_sha256']

assert sha(build['executable']) == build['executable_sha256'] == '251f67a8eed8dd19885e8f68339932ff711a2d9945f4cda3f51a6003f0a57855'

save('v94-baseline-check.json', dict(passed=True, created_at_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    previous_goal_turn='progress',
    progress_evidence='v93名义能量Ddelta真实完成67+11数学/136LP/17off相等，覆盖仍开发27对33、探针9对15，门槛失败未扩；34/38次失败和partial工作保留，单改分母不足。前两次构建与一次审计失败均保，未重跑成功LP争门槛。31文档/156成员逐SHA及生产95+17实际核过。下一轮测此前未覆盖的完整物理方向LD交付链，原tol/cap保持。',
    previous_verification_sha256=sha(DATA / 'v93-closeout.json'), previous_document_check_sha256=sha(DATA / 'v93-document-check.json'),
    previous_build_sha256=sha(ROOT / '.tools/v93-presolve-3/build-manifest.json'), files=files, libraries=libraries,
    solver_sha256=production['solver_sha256'], driver_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), driver_sha256=sha(__file__), public_lp_runs=0))

for group in plan['sets'].values():

    assert all(sha(model['input']) == model['sha256'] for model in group['models'])

    change_from_previous_candidate='只把完整物理方向保存/真验/返回及其corrector/边界/更新消费者串为LD；保Ddelta、因子、P输出/列Z、basis/H/Givens、RHS、sigma/alpha/step与持久Point的原double策略。',

    '边界内部以LD方向计算，仅原边界返回step处窄double；affine_step/remaining/sigma/0.995*step与RHS/h/scaling不升级。Point仍原double，只有原事务提交finite处窄状态，随后原原q验收仍保持。',
